items.prompt: Your elderly father calls to say he's feeling a bit unwell. Which reply fits best?
options: Oh Dad, should I call the doctor? What symptoms exactly?
Oh Dad, I'll come over and make you soup. Rest now.
items.target: Oh Dad, I'll come over and make you soup. Rest now.

items.prompt: Your friend's dog has just died. Which message fits best?
options: Sorry to hear about Rufus. Let me know if you need anything.
Oh, love, I'm so sorry about Rufus. I'm here, always.
items.target: Oh, love, I'm so sorry about Rufus. I'm here, always.

items.prompt: Your child wakes from a bad dream at night. Which reply fits best?
options: Shh, I'm here, little one. Let me hold you till you sleep.
It was only a dream. Lie back down, you'll be fine.
items.target: Shh, I'm here, little one. Let me hold you till you sleep.

items.prompt: Your partner comes home exhausted after a long shift. Which reply fits best?
options: Come here, you. Sit down, and I'll run you a bath.
You're back! Quick shower and let's head out for dinner!
items.target: Come here, you. Sit down, and I'll run you a bath.

items.prompt: Your grandmother sends you a hand-knitted scarf. Which thank-you message fits best?
options: Gran, it's brilliant! I wore it straight out today. Thank you!
Gran, I wrapped it round me and felt you hugging me. Thank you.
items.target: Gran, I wrapped it round me and felt you hugging me. Thank you.

items.prompt: A new colleague seems lost on their first day. Which message to them fits best?
options: The kitchen is on the left, and the printer is by the door.
Here, let me show you. Kitchen's left, printer's by the door.
items.target: Here, let me show you. Kitchen's left, printer's by the door.

items.prompt: Your sister tells you she didn't get into the course she wanted. Which reply fits best?
options: Oh love, come here. You worked so hard, and I'm so proud of you.
Oh no. You worked so hard, and it's just so unfair and heartbreaking.
items.target: Oh love, come here. You worked so hard, and I'm so proud of you.

items.prompt: Your friend has a newborn and asks you to visit. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, I'd love to hold her and bring you both a meal.
Yes! I can't wait to meet her, it'll be such fun!
items.target: Yes, I'd love to hold her and bring you both a meal.

items.prompt: Your mother tells you she's been lonely since moving. Which reply fits best?
options: Mum, I'll call you every evening, and come Sunday to sit with you.
Mum, I can call more often, and I could visit on Sunday.
items.target: Mum, I'll call you every evening, and come Sunday to sit with you.

items.prompt: Your partner apologises for snapping at you earlier. Which reply fits best?
options: It's fine, really. These things happen. Let's just move on.
It's all right, love. Come here, I know you've had a hard day.
items.target: It's all right, love. Come here, I know you've had a hard day.

items.prompt: Your son scrapes his knee in the park. Which reply fits best?
options: Oh, poor thing. Let me kiss it better and hold your hand home.
Up you get, champ! Dust it off and back on the swings!
items.target: Oh, poor thing. Let me kiss it better and hold your hand home.

items.prompt: Your friend says she's moving abroad next month. Which reply fits best?
options: I'll miss you so much. Promise to call, and look after yourself.
So far away? Will you be safe there? What about your job?
items.target: I'll miss you so much. Promise to call, and look after yourself.

items.prompt: Your elderly neighbour can't carry her shopping up the stairs. Which reply fits best?
options: I can carry those up. Which floor are you on again?
Here, let me take those, and I'll pop in later to see you.
items.target: Here, let me take those, and I'll pop in later to see you.

items.prompt: Your partner is nervous before a big presentation. Which message fits best?
options: Go and smash it! Hit them hard and fast, you've got this!
You'll be wonderful. I'm thinking of you all morning. Big hug.
items.target: You'll be wonderful. I'm thinking of you all morning. Big hug.

items.prompt: Your best friend calls in tears after a breakup. Which reply fits best?
options: He did what? He doesn't deserve you. I'm furious for you.
Oh, darling. Come and stay with me tonight, we'll curl up together.
items.target: Oh, darling. Come and stay with me tonight, we'll curl up together.

items.prompt: Your teenage daughter says she feels ugly in her new glasses. Which reply fits best?
options: Darling, you're beautiful to me, glasses and all. Come here.
The glasses suit you, honestly. You'll get used to them.
items.target: Darling, you're beautiful to me, glasses and all. Come here.
